summary.en: An Ansible role collection for an RPM-based server: Docker with cAdvisor, an ELK stack and Weave Scope, Graphite and Grafana, PostgreSQL and hardening.
summary.cs: Sada Ansible rolí pro server na RPM distribuci: Docker s cAdvisorem, ELK stackem a Weave Scope, Graphite a Grafana, PostgreSQL a zabezpečení.

problem.en: A single box for data work needs containers, metrics, logs and a database, and setting that up by hand does not repeat well.
problem.cs: Jeden stroj pro práci s daty potřebuje kontejnery, metriky, logy a databázi, a ruční nastavení se špatně opakuje.

solution.en: role-server.yml applies EPEL, OS upgrade, collectd, Docker, dockerised cAdvisor, ELK and Weave Scope, fail2ban, Grafana with Graphite and Prometheus datasources and panel plugins, Graphite, mosh, PostgreSQL and tools. Roles for PostGIS, Rust, nmap, git and Atomic exist but are commented out, a Prometheus role is not in the play, the Grafana dashboard import is commented out, and a separate test playbook applies only PostgreSQL; a shell script runs each playbook.
solution.cs: role-server.yml aplikuje EPEL, upgrade OS, collectd, Docker, cAdvisor v kontejneru, ELK a Weave Scope, fail2ban, Grafanu se zdroji dat Graphite a Prometheus a s pluginy panelů, Graphite, mosh, PostgreSQL a nástroje. Role pro PostGIS, Rust, nmap, git a Atomic existují, ale jsou zakomentované, role Prometheus v playbooku není, import dashboardu do Grafany je zakomentovaný a samostatný testovací playbook nasadí jen PostgreSQL; každý playbook spouští shellový skript.
